description: This source file defines the Drawing class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for converting measurement units, creating images, and related drawing utilities.

classes.name: Drawing
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for handling drawing-related conversions and operations in PHPSpreadsheet.

methods.name: pixelsToEMU
methods.description: Converts pixel units to EMU (English Metric Units).

methods.name: pixelsToCellDimension
methods.description: Converts pixel units to Excel cell dimension units based on font metrics.

methods.name: cellDimensionToPixels
methods.description: Converts Excel cell dimension units to pixel units based on font metrics.

methods.name: degreesToAngle
methods.description: Converts degrees to angle units used in graphics.

methods.name: angleToDegrees
methods.description: Converts angle units back to degrees.

methods.name: imagecreatefrombmp
methods.description: Creates an image resource from a BMP file. Deprecated; recommends using PHP's built-in imagecreatefrombmp() when available.
